priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup — `src/socket.ts:3 RIGHT` — the returned cleanup remains a no-op while the registered handler is still attached.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: When a consumer invokes the returned cleanup function, the `"message"` handler remains registered because the function does nothing. This retains the handler and can cause callbacks after detachment or duplicate processing after repeated attachment; restore `socket.off("message", handler)` in the cleanup path.
